rows: Garment Manufacturing | PDF Techpack → WFX BOM Update Register
New trim item added to style

Yes, Merchants Redownload the Updated techpack from buyer portal in case if any is added to the existing bom. Items mostly packing trims are newly added into the techpack. In updated techpack previous Items will always remain constant,only new added items will get added into new line

Yes, there is possibility that existing item will be removed from the techpack and New Item code for the same catagory will be added . In this case if RMPO is created for the deleted item then user do not want to remove the line , instead add a new line for the new material code
Pantone reference revised(Material Color or Reference Code revised)

Yes, There is possiblity to add New colors into the updated techpack with existing materials. 
Even there are cases where existing colors get updated for the same material in updated techpack
Yes, There are cases where Buyer send additional style colors in order which were not there in inital stage of Techpack creation.
Yes, There are cases where Buyer send additional style Sizes in order which were not there in inital stage of Techpack creation.

Yes, Merchants Redownload the Updated techpack from buyer portal in case if any new item is added to the existing bom. Items mostly like packing trims are newly added into the techpack. In updated techpack previous Items will always remain constant,only new added items will get added into a new line
There is no change in any of the Style Header level information in Techpack Updation

6 | Trim & Accessories | Hang Tag | New compliance hang tag added | Yes, Merchants Redownload the Updated techpack from buyer portal in case if any new item is added to the existing bom. Items mostly like packing trims are newly added into the techpack. In updated techpack previous Items will always remain constant,only new added items will get added into a new line
7 | Style |  | Style Information Changes | There is no change in any of the Style Header level information in Techpack Updation
